Jiangsu Province's 18 AI OPC Support Measures

A comprehensive English summary of the Jiangsu Provincial Government's official policy to support AI-powered One-Person Companies — from tax relief and subsidized computing to housing guarantees and a 100 billion RMB credit facility.

In July 2026, the Jiangsu Provincial Development and Reform Commission issued a landmark policy document outlining 18 support measures for AI-powered One-Person Companies (OPCs). This is the first provincial-level policy in China to explicitly define and support the AI OPC business model — recognizing it as a core driver of the "AI+" national strategy.

The policy applies to legally operating AI OPCs with teams of up to 10 people, covering five key areas: cluster development, key resource support, talent services, innovation applications, and ecosystem optimization.

Key Figures

Policy Highlights at a Glance

100B RMB

Dedicated OPC credit facility through the provincial strategic emerging industries fund.

Tax Relief

Full implementation of "six taxes and two fees" reductions and small/micro enterprise income tax incentives for qualifying OPCs.

Computing Subsidies

Public computing centers with "computing vouchers" to reduce AI model training and inference costs.

Free Office Space

Low-cost or free office space in specialized OPC communities with integrated policy services.

Full Summary

All 18 Support Measures

Organized by the five key areas outlined in the Jiangsu provincial policy.

1. Promoting OPC Cluster Development

1

Strengthen OPC Entity Cultivation

Build a tiered cultivation system to help qualifying OPCs grow into "little giant" specialized enterprises, high-tech companies, unicorn enterprises, and gazelle companies. Fully implement "six taxes and two fees" reductions and small/micro enterprise income tax incentives.

2

Build Specialized OPC Communities

Accelerate the development of specialized OPC communities offering low-cost office space, integrated policy services, shared computing power, shared language data, model services, R&D support, scenario matching, financial investment, and professional services (legal, tax, IP). Explore a unified online OPC community platform for Jiangsu Province.

3

Accelerate OPC Commercialization

Encourage OPCs to undertake core technology challenges and participate in "open bidding" projects. Strengthen AI commercialization platforms including concept verification centers and pilot-testing facilities to reduce the cost and time from technology validation to market launch.

2. Strengthening Key Resource Support

4

Reduce Computing Costs

Build public computing centers with shared computing resource pools. Local governments encouraged to issue "computing vouchers" to reduce AI model training and inference costs for OPCs.

5

Increase Data Resource Supply

Create high-quality datasets and language model corpora. Promote compliant public data opening, authorized enterprise data circulation, and industry data integration. Support trusted data space construction. Issue "data vouchers" to reduce data acquisition costs.

6

Facilitate Model Deployment

Support OPCs in building intelligent agents via API access to foundational models or secure private deployment. Encourage "token vouchers" and "model vouchers" to lower development, deployment, and operational costs.

7

Improve Innovation Support System

Establish dedicated funding for vertical-domain large models and intelligent agent R&D within the provincial key frontier technology program. Encourage universities and research institutes to provide pre-trained model libraries and algorithm toolkits to lower the barrier for OPC innovation.

3. Strengthening Talent Service Guarantees

8

One-Stop Entrepreneurship Services

Provide integrated "single-window" services for company registration, bank account opening, and tax registration. Pilot AI-assisted name declaration and automated business scope matching. Optimize full-lifecycle support for OPC entrepreneurs.

9

Expand OPC Talent Development

Build a full-chain talent development system spanning basic education, higher education, and vocational training. Add OPC categories to the Jiangsu University Student Innovation Competition and Jiangsu Entrepreneurship Lecture series. Support professional skills training and AI-related professional title evaluations.

10

Provide OPC Housing Guarantees

Eligible OPC talent can access a three-tier housing policy: free short-term stays at "Suqing Relay Stations," discounted long-term rentals at youth apartments, and full integration into youth communities. Additional support through talent rental housing and housing coupon subsidies.

4. Supporting OPC Innovation Applications

11

Open Scenario Innovation Mechanism

Establish a "Scenario Manager" service system within OPC communities to diagnose needs and match real-world scenarios. Promote cross-department, cross-industry, and cross-regional scenario sharing. Build scenario open innovation centers and organize regular AI application roadshows and matchmaking events.

12

Deepen Scenario Integration

Push OPC integration into healthcare, sports economy, and other key consumer sectors. Support OPC participation in medical AI R&D, clinical diagnosis, traditional medicine, public health, and scientific research. Leverage events like the "Su Chao" league to build intelligent service platforms across culture, sports, commerce, and tourism.

5. Optimizing the OPC Ecosystem

13

Strengthen Standards Leadership

Support OPC participation in standards-setting for model innovation, scenario applications, and ecosystem services. Provide rewards for OPCs that lead the development of international or national standards.

14

IP Compliance Guidance

Issue OPC intellectual property compliance guidelines. Open a dedicated "OPC IP Service Zone" on the provincial IP innovation platform with a compliance self-check tool and resource map. Establish a green channel for AI patent fast-tracking. Awards of up to 1M RMB (China Patent Award) and 300K RMB (Jiangsu Patent Award).

15

Build a Financial Service System

Leverage the provincial strategic emerging industries fund and partner with municipal governments and private capital to increase AI investment. Provide "financing + empowerment" support across seed, startup, and growth stages. Financial institutions encouraged to create a 100 billion RMB OPC special credit product with interest subsidies and risk compensation.

16

Provide Quality Legal Services

Establish mediation organizations within OPC communities for dispute resolution. Encourage law firms to form specialized OPC legal teams covering risk prevention, IP protection, and data security. Create efficient arbitration channels and "one-stop" legal service centers.

17

Cultivate an Active Innovation Ecosystem

Strengthen provincial OPC brand building through competitions (e.g., "Su Chuang Zhu Pao" OPC Innovation Contest, Jiangsu "Chuang Qing Chun" AI+Transport Contest), exhibitions, industry-academia matchmaking events, investment roadshows, and industry salons. Foster a "one person, one army" entrepreneurial culture.

18

Strengthen Safety Governance

Balance OPC development with security. Improve security literacy, coordinate technology innovation with governance, and support local governments, parks, and enterprises in building public AI safety service capabilities within OPC communities.

For Foreign Entrepreneurs

What This Means for You

Government Backing

Jiangsu's provincial government is actively investing in the OPC model — this is official confirmation that the structure is here to stay and will receive growing support.

Financial Benefits

From tax reductions to computing subsidies and a 100B RMB credit line, the policy creates tangible financial advantages for qualifying OPCs — including foreign-owned ones.

Community Infrastructure

The policy mandates the creation of OPC communities with integrated services — legal, tax, IP, shared computing — making it easier than ever to operate as a solo entrepreneur.

Why Suzhou?

Suzhou Industrial Park is Jiangsu's flagship innovation zone, making it the ideal base to benefit from both these provincial measures and SIP-level programs like the Jinji Lake Leading Talent initiative.
